description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs chain_walk(): cert.tbs_certificate.encode_to_slice(&mut tbs_buf) where tbs_buf=[0u8; 8192]. A valid cert with TBS > 8 KiB (large government/enterprise CA certs with extensive NameConstraints, policy OIDs, or HSM attestation certs) returns Error::Der(e) where e is a DER encoding-overflow error. The caller sees 'DER error: ...' for a cert that is structurally valid — the error blames DER when the real problem is an internal buffer too small. The cert is valid, the user's input is correct, but they receive a DER parse error with no actionable guidance. Add a variant Error::CertificateTooLarge or at minimum add a comment in the Der variant docs that this can indicate oversized (valid) input.
title: TBS 8 KiB stack buffer returns misleading Der error for large valid certs
